before: Paragraphs had no search method, collections refused items/ load paths, and a removed held object gave no specific reason.
after: Paragraph.search reads matches in one paragraph, collections load item properties through items/ paths in one sync, and a handle whose object was removed reports edit.stale-target.
reason: The editing API adds read operations and an error diagnostic only. The engine marks removed-object refusals with a detail token that maps to an existing public code. It adds no shared fields and leaves the collaboration format and write operations unchanged.
